scope: Supplied starting values for a single-core live demo; native importer and actual initial transport optimization remain in progress.

actual_wasm.scope: Actual single-core Pyodide arbitrary-precision data import; no RustFlow transport or amplitude calculation.

limitations: WASM import time excludes runtime startup, package download, mathematical certificate validation and insertion into a solver boundary cache.
This is not a WASM transport or amplitude timing. The current community WASM build excludes the loop evaluator.
The live notebook adapter, exact mathematical certificate and generic supplied-boundary insertion still require end-to-end integration validation.
Original frozen scientific bank unchanged; no destination points or amplitudes are included.
retained_initial_probe_failure: The first WASM probe asserted every error had the coefficient working precision. Some error estimates intentionally retain a different precision. The probe was corrected to compare each error with its own exported precision; exact values were preserved.
